Built for coffee lovers who demand café-quality performance anywhere they brew, the AeroPress Manual Coffee Grinder combines high performance grind precision with an ultra-slim, travel-ready design. 

Italian-made, Titanium-Coated Conical Burrs – Made in Italy, our premium stainless steel burrs with titanium coating ensure long-lasting durability and precise, consistent grinding of coffee beans. This manual coffee grinder offers the control and consistency coffee lovers expect from top electric coffee grinders—without the cords.

60+ Adjustable Grind Settings – Fine-tune your grind size from espresso-fine to coarse.  Dial in and customize for AeroPress, pour-over, French press, cold brew, or drip coffee.   Comes preset to medium-fine for AeroPress.


Compact & Travel-Ready Design – Portable hand coffee grinder features an ultra slim, durable all metal build and a magnetic hand crank that slides into the body of the grinder so the entire assembly fits neatly inside an AeroPress coffee maker.  Inch for inch the most compact, high-performance grinder on the market  - perfect for travel, camping, or at home.


Smooth Hand Crank Coffee Grinder Operation – Easy-Grind™ ergonomic handle with dual bearings ensures fast, smooth grinding and comfortable operation. Compatible with an optional Power Drill Adapter for ultra-fast grinding when you need extra speed.  


Limited Lifetime Warranty -  Lifetime warranty covers the burr set for normal use, and a one-year warranty applies to the rest of the grinder.
